# OM-3 Film Rolls from the card, v0.41-beta2 and beta3

A roll of 24, 36 or 72 exposures fixes film and ISO, counts down, hides review until rewind and logs to the card; the maintainer reports camera tests.

**Camera:** [OM SYSTEM OM-3](../cameras/om3.md) · **Project:** [Caduceus for OM-3](../projects/caduceus-om3.md)

**Firmware:** [om3 firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om3-1100.md) · **Mod build:** v0.41-beta2 (fr9 with FILMROLL.BIN of test 39); v0.41-beta3 (fix116-1)

With the release's FILMROLL folder in OM3MOD, a roll picked on Picture Mode's film row keeps its film and ISO, counts the frames left, keeps Playback and Image Review off and stops bursts at the last frame, locks the shutter at the end, winds back with the rear dial and is listed in OM3MOD/FILMROLL/ROLLS.TXT. Without the folder the flashed hooks run as stock.

**Availability:** published release. **Implementation basis:** reported.

## Supporting observations

No separate test observation is catalogued. The assertion is attributed to its sources; release availability does not establish test coverage.

## Limits

- Maintainer-reported camera tests on the owner's OM-3 (fr9, test 39, fix116-1); no independent report or package-level camera log has been imported.
- FILMROLL.BIN is built for one firmware build; beta2's file is not loaded by beta3, so card and firmware must match.
- A "not developed" screen in Playback froze the camera on leaving Playback and was dropped; Playback does nothing during a roll instead.
- The design document lists little space left in the flashed firmware's patch sections and a full release still to come.
